finalText:
Fixed. The error was on line 17 of `src/core/settings.js` — it referenced an undefined variable `retries` instead of `env.retries`. That's why `maxRetries` came back as `undefined` instead of the number `3` the caller passed in.

I also added the missing `parallelism` fallback while I was there. Build now finishes clean with 3 warnings and 0 errors. The warnings are all noise (deprecated API, unused export, circular import) — they don't block the build.
